title: Strict inclusion of log space in polynomial space
statement: The class of languages decidable by finite Turing machines using space bounded by a constant multiple of $\log_2(n)+1$ is a proper subset of the class of languages decidable using space bounded by a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ for some natural number $c$.
